svg.metadata: Handwriting based on Hershey Script 1-stroke. The Hershey Fonts were originally created by Dr. A. V. Hershey at the U. S. National Bureau of Standards. Original font-data format by James Hurt, Cognition, Inc., 900 Technology Park Drive, Billerica, MA 01821 (mit-eddie!ci-dandelion!hurt). SVG font conversion by Windell H.
